Had Invisalign done. Not happy with the result or the process. Teeth are still crooked, but dentist kept giving me fake excuses, such as “that tooth can’t move” or “that tooth only looks crooked because it’s chipped” (it’s not chipped. It’s just crooked, still.) Never got my refinement due to the many excuses and gaslighting. And during the process of getting my retainer, the lab kept breaking the mould and I had to go in 3 times to the clinic to have them take a new mould of my teeth because they threw away the old ones right away. Took a whole month to finally get the retainer. Spent 75k just to waste time. It’s okay if you have nowhere else or live nearby, but there are better places to choose from.
